title: NDA Life #2 · 3 roads after NDA: IMA, INA, AFA

captions.instagram:
After 3 years at NDA, 3 roads to 3 academies 🇮🇳

1 Army cadets → Indian Military Academy, Dehradun. 1 more year, then Lieutenant.
2 Naval cadets → Indian Naval Academy, Ezhimala. 1 more year, then Sub-Lieutenant.
3 Air Force cadets → Air Force Academy, Hyderabad (Dundigal). About a year later, Flying Officer (pilots keep flying training for another six months; Ground Duty Tech cadets go to the Air Force Technical College, Bengaluru).

You don't pick a road at NDA: you list the services in order of preference when you apply to UPSC.

Which road is yours? Comment 1, 2 or 3 👇

All 3 roads start with the written exam: maths is 300 of the 900 marks.

Source: UPSC's NDA & NA notice. Our own model, not a map, not to scale.
